units.titles: Unchecked sender in QueryOracle function leading to potential oracle manip- | Invalid signature handling in ConfirmReport function
units.known_address_notes: Zellic audit (2024) of eBridge's lock/release + oracle/confirm-report contracts; findings reference QueryOracle and ConfirmReport. Chain confirmed: aelf <> Ethereum <> BNB Smart Chain (ebridge.exchange states decentralised nodes on those three). Report PDF contains no deployed addresses; ebridge.exchange ships no address list; aelf-side contracts use aelf base58 addresses rather than 0x, so without an aelf explorer seed they cannot be named. EVM-side bridge address unpublished -> PARTIAL.

Hacken reviewed Ripio's LaChain ChainBridge (Bridge.sol / ERC20Handler.sol, Polygon+others, Oct-2023) and publishes no addresses. LaChain mainnet is alive and reachable this pass (chain 274, rpc1.mainnet.lachain.network block 23,472,941), but its explorer (explorer.lachain.network, Blockscout build) exposes no working api/v2 or api?module endpoint (all return the SPA 404 page), the gitbook is an unfinished template with no contract registry, and no Ripio bridge repo/address surfaced. PARTIAL: ch
